# MD4C

Unmodified upstream MD4C v0.6.0 source, commit
`7fc1815a5eeba2af7d6120a76202bf59f3b6e6e4`, downloaded 2026-10-01 from
https://github.com/mity/md4c. Retained MIT license: LICENSE.md. Files: md4c.c,
md4c.h, entity.c, entity.h. SwiftEdit links the parser and entity lookup only,
not an HTML renderer or browser. Upstream code is outside the first-party house
style audit; the named C++ adapter in src/markdown.cpp is included in that audit.
